Issue: Baylight and Paper Route browser previews do not resemble the games and call themselves prototypes
Evidence: Live pages vs store screenshots; 'Interactive Web Prototype', 'Development Notice' in page copy
Player impact: Visitor sees a weaker product than the real game
Business impact: Likely lowers store clicks from previews
Proposed solution: Reword now (P0-7); reskin or retire (P3-4, P3-5)
Acceptance criteria: No emoji game pieces; no 'prototype' wording

Issue: Home page shows no gameplay image
Acceptance criteria: Two screenshots visible in the first band

Issue: Home leads with what is missing (iPhone, Mila)
Proposed solution: Move availability notes into each band
Acceptance criteria: First screen shows a game and an action

Issue: Badge, play link and hub link have equal weight
Proposed solution: Play button primary, badge second, text link third
Acceptance criteria: One visually dominant action per band

Issue: iPhone visitors see a Google Play badge first
Proposed solution: Device-aware order with a complete no-script default
Acceptance criteria: iPhone view shows play action and note, no Play badge in bands

Issue: Only Ninely has an end-of-play store card
Acceptance criteria: Card shown and focused at round end

Issue: No cross-promotion between games
Evidence: No 'more games' block on hubs or playables
Acceptance criteria: Present on four games, absent on Mila

Issue: Ratings and install counts are too small to show
Proposed solution: Do not display ratings or counts
Acceptance criteria: No ratings or counts in copy or markup

Issue: Palette is a leftover casino felt and gold; favicon and share image disagree with the site
Proposed solution: Charcoal frame, ring logo, per-game colours
Acceptance criteria: Tokens in site.css; ring in header

Issue: Share image shows 'aviisr-games' and four icons
No shared header or navigation
Evidence: Each hub has its own link row

Issue: Paper Route split across /paper-route/ and /morning-route/
Hub link label 'About, help and privacy' undersells the hub
Proposed solution: Title and band link to hub

Issue: Mixed-direction grid looks unplanned
Small touch targets (polish; passes WCAG 2.5.8 through exceptions)
Evidence: Measured: 23 px card links, 17 px footer links
Acceptance criteria: All links at least 24 px high

Issue: Language select has no visible label
Emoji used as game pieces in playables
Multiple h1 on nine pages
No real screen reader session run

Issue: Open Graph tags missing on some playables and guides

Issue: Organization logo points to an SVG favicon

Duplicate titles and descriptions

favicon.ico 404

Issue: Casino trainer links to a dead App Store id and a Play package that returns 404; store-link test scans allowlisted pages only

Issue: No HSTS or framing headers
unsafe-inline in policies; innerHTML on twelve pages
New analytics events exceed what the privacy page lists
Privacy page does not list the live qr_land event

Issue: No play or navigation events
Business impact: Cannot tell whether browser play helps
Proposed solution: Events in document 10, shipped before the redesign (P5-2)

Issue: Install attribution unavailable
Proposed solution: Document the gap; revisit with App Store campaign links

Issue: Names, links and availability repeated by hand across pages
Evidence: 41 pages; tests exist to catch drift

Issue: Traffic too low for split tests
Redesign must follow the owner's 28-day gate and four weeks of event baseline
Proposed solution: Order: fixes and events, baseline, gate review, then build
Acceptance criteria: Baseline recorded before any redesign merges

Issue: Home bands must not offer a play button for previews that undersell the game
Proposed solution: Baylight and Paper Route bands show badge and screenshots until reskinned
